cwe_name: Inclusion of Web Functionality from an Untrusted Source

exact_cwe_mechanism.evidence: CWE-830 requires inclusion of web functionality/widgets from untrusted external domains. The demonstrated behavior is a configuration processing bug that forces highlight=true, not inclusion of external web functionality.

connection.evidence: Configuration values come from meta.settings.get('markdown') with defaults. The bug connects user configuration to highlight functionality, but no external domain inclusion is demonstrated.

diff_causality.evidence: If the candidate line were reverted, the highlight setting would properly reflect user configuration instead of being forced to true. The bug materially creates incorrect configuration behavior.

security_control.required_control: Validation of external web functionality sources
security_control.control_requirement_evidence: CWE-830 requires controls to validate external web functionality sources before inclusion
security_control.deficiency_evidence: No evidence of external web functionality inclusion or validation controls. The demonstrated issue is a logical OR bug in configuration processing, not external source validation.

concrete_impact.evidence: No concrete security impact demonstrated. The bug forces syntax highlighting but no evidence shows this enables inclusion of untrusted web functionality or creates security consequences.

diff_counterfactual: If the candidate line were reverted, the highlight setting would properly evaluate to false when config.highlight is false, allowing users to disable syntax highlighting as intended.
supporting_evidence: Configuration processing bug that overrides user settings
Highlight functionality is exposed via /markdown/config API endpoint
contradicting_evidence: No evidence of external web functionality inclusion
No demonstration of untrusted source integration
The bug affects local configuration processing, not external resource loading
unresolved_facts: Whether highlight functionality involves external web resources
If syntax highlighting library has security implications
What specific web functionality is being included from untrusted sources
